Commentary.Commentary: Prithvi Shaw is adjudged the Man of the Match for his solid knock of 94. That's it from us from this game. Thank you for tuning in. Do join us for India's next game against Papua New Guinea on the 16th of January, 2018. Till next time, take care and cheers!

Nobody from the lower order could take their team through and a couple of run outs added to their wounds. India were bowling good lines right throughout the innings. Especially, Kamlesh Nagarkoti and Shivam Mavi who bent their backs too. India were a bit sloppy on the field but luckily for them, it didn't cost them as much as it did to Australia. So, with this win India now get two points but are second on the table with a lower net run rate as compared to Zimbabwe.

Comfortable win for India at the end. Australia kept losing wickets at regular intervals in the middle and kept it too late for anything to be done. They had a decent opening partnership with Edwards playing from one end. He kept getting support from his partners till Merlo lost his stumps. The run rate just kept on increasing after that it was all one way traffic.

OUT! That's it. INDIA WIN BY  100 RUNS. Full toss on leg and Holt looks to pull this ball, he doesn't connect and the ball goes to hit the thigh pad. The umpire takes his time and eventually raises his finger.
Lloyd Pope comes in next to bat.

OUT! Oh boy! Another run out! Forcefully sent the non-striker for the second run and Ralston is well short of his crease. Full ball on leg, Holt flicks it on the leg and they try coming for the second run. Ralston slips while taking the first run but is told to come back for the second. The umpire gives him out without asking the TV umpire.
FOUR! Length outside off and Holt goes hard on it. Gets an edge to it and the ball flies to the third man region for another boundary.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller in length and Holt works it to mi-wicket for a run.
This one is worked on the leg side for a run.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short ball on leg, Holt pulls it in front of square to pick up a brace.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! This time he connects well. Short ball once again and Holt slaps it over the mid-wicket region for a maximum.
FOUR! Short again and Holt pulls the ball this time. He too manages to get a top edge to eat but the ball goes past the keeper's head on the bounce to the fence.
Jason Ralston walks in next.
OUT! Eight down now Australia. Short ball on leg, Bartlett looks to pull this but only manages a top edge to it. The keeper calls for it and collects it well.
FOUR! Another one which goes through that slip cordon. Full around off, Bartlett slashes hard on it but only manages an outside edge to it. The ball races away to the third man region for a boundary.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
This one is full around off and Bartlett lofts it over mid off to pick up one run.
Shivam Mavi gets the ball to bowl.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Run out chance missed! Just needed a direct throw to the keeper and Holt was short of his ground. Cut this ball around off and it goes to the man at backward point.
Sweep and miss again. Fuller ball on legs and Holt misses his sweep yet again.
The batsman goes for the sweep but fails to connect it.
Darts this on the pads of Holt who sweeps this away to deep square leg for two runs.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
The batsman attempts to hook that one but fails to make contact.
FOUR! On the pads of Holt and he flicks it away to square leg. The ball is air-borne but just falls short of the charging square leg man. A boundary results.
Short ball on middle and leg, Holt pulls this front of square to pick up another brace.
Short of length hurries on, Bartlett fends it away awkwardly to third man.
Xavier Bartlett comes in next to bat.

OUT! The best sight for a fast bowler seeing the stumps coming out off its root. Full ball on off and Sutherland looks to heave this ball but doesn't get under it. The ball goes on to disturb the furniture.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman plays the Square-Cut. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Drifting away from Sutherland and he whips it away from his pads to pick up two runs.
Tossed up, Holt drives this through covers for one.
The batsman has been hit on the pads as he tried to sweep that one.
Spinning into Holt and the ball hits him on the pads. A stifled appeal from the players.
Short ball again and Holt doesn't time the hook shot. He gets a top edge to it and the ball falls short of the charging fine leg fielder. They pick up a run.
Fired in line of the stumps at a good length, Holt works it to mid-wicket.
Bouncer! And a quick one around off. Holt goes for the hook but misses it.
The batsman gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Wide. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The Umpire signals a wide and they run through for a single.
This one is a full ball, and Holt drives it down the ground for a run.
Fuller ball to start with and Holt hits it back off the bowler to pick up two runs.
SIX! Nicely done! Pitched up ball, Sutherland kneels down and smacks it above the bowlers head for a maximum.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
The batsman plays the Square-Cut. They pick up a single.
Baxter J Holt walks in next.
OUT! Bowled' em! This one goes straight through him. Quicker through the air as it was a straighter one. Edwards looks to cut it but is beaten all ends up. The off stump goes for a walk.
Tossed up, Sutherland drives this towards covers this time. Another run taken.
Pitched up, Edwards drives it through covers for one.
Anukul Sudhakar Roy comes in to bowl.
Will Sutherland walks in next.

OUT! Nagarkoti strikes! Look what pace can do to you. Kamlesh bowls this full outside off at 144 kph. The length invites the batter for a drive and Waugh obliges. All he manages is a thick outside edge that is pouched easily by Juyal behind. India are locking the game out here already. They require 5 more wickets for a win as the Aussies are still 163 runs away.
Look at the pace - 145 kph! Waugh gets down the track but fails to make any contact to this one.
Steve Waugh is on the ground, watching his kid perform.
Banged short on the stumps, Austin misses the pull.
This is outside off, played towards point.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, Waugh looks to cut but misses.
Kamlesh Nagarkoti back on to bowl.
This one is swept away towards square leg for one.
Slip comes back. This is the bowler's demand.
Nicely bowled. Tossed up ball outside off, draws Waugh forward before beating him due to the spin. The keeper collects it and whips off the bails but the batter is well in.
Waugh sweeps again but for nothing.

No slip and the ball goes there! What are you doing, Shaw? Why no slip here? Abhishek floats this one outside off, Waugh looks to force this through covers. Gets a thick outside edge through the slip cordon for a couple.
The slip goes out now.
Nicely eased through the mid off region for one.
Now, there's a slip in place for Sharma.
Floated on the stumps, swept away to short fine leg for one.
Wonderful ball even to a set batsman. Mavi bowls a slower leg cutter just outside off, Edwards looks to run it down to third man but misses. There is a fumble by the keeper but nothing results.
This one is flicked away off the pads for a single.
This is outside off, pushed towards point.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. One run added to the total. Leg byes given by the umpire.
Driven through mid off by Waugh. They pick up a single.
Edwards guides this with an angled bat to third man for a single.
Austin Waugh walks in next.
Drinks are on the field now.

OUT! A mix up in the middle and that proves to be fatal! This is bowled on the pads, Edwards works it towards square leg. Uppal always wanted a run and was quickly down the track in search for one. Edwards was unsure in his response and sends out mixed signals. He eventually comes down for a run but meanwhile Uppal spots the fielder get to the ball and decides against the run. As he turns back, it looks as if both the batters are in a running race. The throw is returned to the keeper by Mavi, who disturbs the stumps there. Eventually Uppal sacrifices his wicket. Horrible mix up, horrible end result.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Flatter outside off, Edwards fails to cut it away.
FOUR! Beautifully played this time. Edwards goes inside out over covers and helps himself a boundary. Much in command this time.

FOUR! Another one! A vacant slip cordon seems to have the Aussies at ease. Now Jack Edwards plays a shot that he wouldn't have if there would have been a slip in position. Sees this nicely tossed up outside off, Edwards frees his arms and looks to go over mid off. Gets a thick outside edge that takes the ball to the third man fence.
Oh, where's the slip? Tossed up nicely outside off, Uppal looks to defend but gets a genuine edge. The ball rolls through the vacant slip cordon for one.
Abhishek Sharma is back into the attack.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Very full on off, jammed out towards backward point for a quick run.
Fuller in line of the stumps, blocked.
Finds the point fielder with this shot.
Uppal is up and running right away. Punches this one through cover-point and picks up a couple.
Param Uppal walks in at the fall of the third wicket.

OUT! The change in bowling does the trick for India. To be honest, this is an unplayable delivery. Mavi runs in from over the wicket and lands it on off. The ball straightens after pitching. Merlo looks to block it out but gets squared up a touch and ends up missing the ball. What's next? Finds his off stump pegged back. Wonderful delivery that, all that he could have done, in hindsight, is perhaps played forward to this one. Another one gone for the Aussies, they are still 184 runs away and have only 119 balls to get there.
Shivam Mavi back on for a bowl.
This one is eased through mid on for one. 13 off this one.
FOUR! This is a poor ball now. Short in length and angling down leg, Merlo goes back and pulls it past short fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Just out of reach! This is full around off, Merlo drives it straight back. Rana raises his right hand up but the ball evades it just and goes down the ground for a boundary.

Excellent job by Abhishek Sharma! The Indians are alternating between poor and excellent fielding display here. This is bowled just outside off, Merlo gets a thin edge past the keeper. It seems to be a boundary till Sharma does well at deep third man fence with a dive. A couple is the end result. The umpire confirms the same after looking at the replay.
Not good this. This length ball is flicked straight to the man at square leg but he lets it through. Two runs result.
Length ball in line of the stumps, punched to mid on.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total. Australia still require 197 runs from 126 balls.
This ball is eased through the mid-wicket region. One run is taken.
Good running. Edwards drives this through covers, sees that the fielder is yet to get to the ball and takes a couple.
Edwards guides it to short third man and thinks of a run, decides against it.
Merlo turns this through mid-wicket and rotates strike.

What an effort! This is bowled just outside off, Merlo cuts it towards point. Nagarkoti at backward point flings himself to his right, fields it and hurls a throw at the non-striker's end. Misses the mark there but full marks for the efforts. Lovely to see a seamer be agile on the field.
Similar ball, similar shot, result the same. Decent over this.
Just outside off, chopped to third man for one.
This one is clipped through square leg to rotate strike.
Edwards plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Nicely played. On the pads, flicked through backward square leg for a brace.
Merlo drives this through mid on for a single.
Himanshu Rana is brought back for a bowl now.
Merlo rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Worked through mid-wicket for one.

SIX! What a shot to get to a fifty! This is his second one at this level and boy, has he looked good today! Gets down to this one and slogs it high and handsome over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
The batsman has driven it through mid-on. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Nicely played. Sees the flight on this one and Merlo bashes it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
This one is pushed towards covers for one.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.

Almost a catch and then a run out chance missed. Merlo looks to work this tossed up ball to the on side but ends up getting a leading edge towards covers. It doesn't carry to Nagarkoti at covers. But he gets there and fails to collect it on the first go which enables the batter to get at the striker's end easily. Had he done better, another wicket would have resulted.
This one is pushed back towards the bowler.
This one is outside off, cut away through point for one.
Flatter on the stumps, punched down to long on for one.
Edwards has played it towards mid-wicket.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Floated ball, in line of the stumps and Merlo comes down to work it on the leg side for a run.
Driven towards the mid on region.
FOUR! Length ball into the pads of Merlo who uses his wrist and flicks it away to the wide fine leg boundary.
Around off and Edwards gets a fat edge to it. The ball goes to third man and they pick up a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Length ball drifting away from Merlo who flicks it away on the leg side and they come back for the third run.
Floated up, around off, Merlo drives this to covers.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Tossed up, Merlo hits it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
Short again and Merlo rocks back again for another run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Shortish ball Merlo punches this ball to pick up a run.
Anukul Sudhakar Roy comes in to bowl.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, Edwards opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a brace.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Shortish ball, Merl rocks back and punches this on the off side for a run.
Jonathan Merlo comes in next to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Slower ball around off, Sangha comes down the track and looks to go over covers but ends up slicing it and the ball flies to the backward point fielder, Shaw for a simple catch.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller ball and Edwards hits it back to the bowler.
Good length ball and a little slower, Jack Edwards is early into the glance and gets a leading edge to cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full ball in line of the stumps and Sangha works it through mid on for a run.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Wide. Way down the leg side. Keeper once again does well to stop the extras.
Outside off, Sangha guides this towards third man to pick up another two runs.
Over pitched ball, Sangha drives it past covers for a run.
Edwards works this to mid on for a run.
Full again on the pads of Edwards who flicks it away for a brace.
Fuller ball, on off Sangha drives this past covers for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Sangha drives this full pitched ball past covers and they come back for the second.
Full again and Edwards flicks it away to move to the other end.
Sangha flicks this full delivery of his pads for a run.
Full again in line of the stumps, Sangha plays it back to the bowler.
Wide. Way down the leg side. The keeper does well to stop it.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Fuller ball, Edwards works it away on the leg for a run.
Himanshu Rana will bowl from the other end.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Shortish ball Sangha looks to cut it but misses.
Edwards plays this ball back past the blower for one.
Length ball on middle and Sangha cuts this past point for another run.
Full pitched ball outside off and Edwards leans forward to loft it over covers. It was a bit air-bone but safe. They pick up a run.
Abhishek Sharma gets his first over.
Back of a length ball and well defended by Sangha.
No word on Ishan Porel injury till now.
Around off and Edwards guides this to third man for another run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On the pads of Edwards and he flicks it away square of the wicket and they come through for the second.
Length again on middle leg, Sangha works it to mid on for a run.
Length ball around off, Edwards opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for a run.
Similar ball and similar shot. One run added to the total.
Darts this on a fuller length, Sangha drives it past covers for another run.
Fires this on the legs of Sangha who works it to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length ball drifting away from Edwards who flicks it away for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length ball, Sangha tries to cut it at the last moment but misses.
Length again around off, Sangha cuts it to point.
FOUR! Short ball going away from Sangha and he manages to get it fine enough to the fine leg boundary.
Sangha defends this length ball from his crease.
Jason Sangha comes in next to bat.
OUT! Bryant is a gonner! Full ball around off and he looks to drive it through covers, doesn't time it well and it flies straight to covers who takes it with a cup. First wicket for the Indians.
Full ball, Bryant drives this to mid off.
Another ball fired in flat on leg, Edwards misses the glance.
Length ball spinning away from Edwards who flicks it to square leg.
Fires this full on leg, Edwards works it to mid-wicket.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman on the leg side.
Fuller this time, Bryant works it to mid on for another run.
Length ball, Bryant cuts it to point.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Fuller this time, Bryant works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Length ball on leg,the ball has struck the batsman on the thigh-pad.
Fires this at a good length around off, Edwards tries to flick it but gets a leading edge to it. Falls in no-man's land. They pick up a single.
Length ball spinning away from Bryant and hits him on his pads. Another stifled appeal from the players.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! Sweet! Tossed up ball and Bryant dances down the wicket and gets under the ball. He lofts it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Fuller this time, Edwards works it to mid on for a run.
Shortish ball on off, Bryant punches this on the off for another run.
Length ball, spinning away from Bryant who flicks it away for a run.
Shiva Singh to continue his spell.
Outside off, Edwards rocks back and cuts it past point for a run.
Fires this at 146 kph. Edwards defends this off his front foot.
Length ball outside off, Bryant cuts it past point for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Bryant plays this ball to mid-wicket.
Length ball sliding down the leg and hits Brayant on his pads. A stifled appeal from the players but nothing from the umpire.
Kamlesh Nagarkoti will bowl now.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. End of the first Powerplay. Australia are 43/0.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Fires this one at a good length on middle and leg, Bryant too flicks it to square leg but gets two for it.
Darts this ball on the legs of Edwards who flicks it away for a run.
Ishan will ot be able to continue his over. Shiva Singh will bowl the rest of the five balls as Porel is seen limping out of the field.
Ishan Porel has just twisted his ankle on his follow through. The physio is out and so is the magic spray. Hope he is fine to continue.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman towards point for nothing.
Length ball around off and the ball nips back after pitching on the surface. Just beats the inside edge of Bryant. They run through.
Worked towards the mid off region.
Around off and Edwards guides it to third man for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, dragged from the off-side and pulled away to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Shivam Mavi to continue his spell.
Length ball around off and Bryant lofts it over mid off to pick up a brace.
Misses the inside edge. great blowing from Porel. Bowls this on a good length around off and the ball nips back of the surface and just misses the inside edge of Bryant.
Length ball around off, Bryant goes for the loft and doesn't get behind the ball.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bryant cuts this ball outside off to the point fielder.
Outside off, Edwards opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a run.
DROPPED! Length ball around off, swinging away from Bryant and he looks to poke at it. It goes to the right of Aryan and he was not ready for it. Puts down a sitter.
Good length ball, around off and Bryant looks to loft this ball. Swings and misses.
Outside off, Bryant cuts it again to point.
Length again, around off, cut to point.
Length ball outside off, Bryant trying to cut it gets an bottom edge to it.
Full ball in line of the stumps, Bryant defends this.
Tries to run this one down to third man but finds the man at backward point.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Edwards once again gets across to this full length ball and this time he chips it uppishly over square leg. Anything on the pads, the batsman feasts on it.
FOUR! Wrists and effective! Fuller ball, on the pads, Edwards shuffles a touch and flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Landed outside off, Edwards with an angled bat pushes it to point.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Jack gets across and flicks it toward short mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery on the hips, tucked towards the leg side.
FOUR! Slashed it! Shortish and outside off, Max goes for the slash and does so uppishly over backward point to find the fence.
Takes a stride forward and drives it to the mid off fielder.
Good length in the channel outside off, Bryant looks to poke at it but is beaten all ends up.
Gets forward and drives it towards the cover fielder.
Gets across and clips it through the leg side for nothing.
Skidding off the surface, on a slower side, Edwards pushes it off the back foot through point for a single.

Inside edge... Good length delivery, angling in from outside off. Edwards is early into his pull shot and as a result he gets an inside edge which evades the top of off stump. The keeper fives full length to his left to slow the ball. A single taken.
Shortish and outside off, slapped through point for a single.
Good comeback delivery! Shortish and zipping off the surface, Bryant looks to poke at it tentatively but is beaten all ends up.
SIX! Slices it over third man! Fuller in length and outside off, Bryant looks to go over cover but slices it over deep point for a biggie. Not in a convincing manner though!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Run out chance! Jack Edwards hops and tucks this one towards square leg and sets off. His partner responds too. The fielder there rushes to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Had that hit, Bryant would have been a goner.
On a length and outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Lets this one come into him as Max defends it solidly.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards backward point.
FOUR! Aerial but safe! Another short ball outside off, Bryant flays it off the outer half over the slip cordon for a boundary.
That took off! Short and rising off the deck, Max looks to bat to it but the extra bounce gets the better of him. The keeper leaps but manages to get a glove to it. This was delivered at 144 kph!
Lands it on a length and it nips back in a touch, Bryant defends it with a straight blade.
FOUR! Powerfully done! Touch short and sits up at a good height too as Jack Edwards murders the pull over mid-wicket for a boundary. First one of the Australian innings!
Fourth leave in a row! Edwards is happy to take his time before getting his eye in. Sees the delivery wider on off, he lets it be.
Hurls it on a length outside off, it straightens a touch after pitching. Edwards shoulders his arms to make a leave.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Jack Edwards shoulders his arms.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Jack doesn't fiddle with it.
Shortish and around off, it moves away off the pitch, Edwards chases after it only to get beaten.
Ishan Porel to bowl with the second new ball.
Shortish and outside off, Bryant looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards the keeper.
Back of a length delivery outside off, cut hard but finds the man at point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Max looks to cut it through the line but the ball doesn't rise and as a result he gets beaten.
Good length delivery on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Plenty of swing on offer, around off, played towards short mid-wicket.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.

We are back for the run chase. 329 needed for Australia to get 2 points in their kitty. The pitch looked like it was slowing down towards the latter half of the first innings. Max Bryant and Jack Edwards. Shivam Mavi to bowl to Edwards first up. Here we go...
